metadata.description: Example A CID (v0.9): Double Wide, +50V, 2500W OPL-MAX, 625W OPL-EMG. PCIe Gen6 x16 inbound on CONN0 via OCP-ratified connector profile; the group name is declared inside the profile and inherited by this connector. No subdividable group, so the paired SCD Definition declares no protocol_group binding. Power block unchanged from v0.7; only opl_max_w and opl_emg_w are declared, so the OAC supports no OPL-SET band.
